intersections.note: Burr Oak St. comes from the west (sheet 653) and ends at Edgewood; no opening on the east side
Mitchell starts here and runs SSE; Epworth bends at this junction (shallow ENE west of it, steeper NE east of it)
McMakin Av. from the west (sheet 653) ends at Edgewood
Orient starts at Mitchell and runs ENE to the right edge
Derby meets Mitchell from the WSW; Mitchell continues south off the sheet
Edgewood ends at Derby; Derby continues west
Euclid Av. comes up from the south (sheet 652) and ends at Derby, just west of Derby's bend

alleys.note: 20 ft alley from Mitchell Av. ENE to the right edge of the sheet, midway between Epworth and Orient

bends.note: Derby runs due east from Edgewood to here, then turns ENE (about 26 deg) up to Mitchell

notes: Single panel. Edgewood Av. (50 ft) runs down the left edge with Burr Oak St., Epworth, McMakin Av. and Derby meeting it from the west. Epworth runs ENE to the top right; Mitchell Av. (40 ft) runs SSE from Epworth to the bottom edge; Orient Av. runs ENE from Mitchell to the right edge. Derby width printed 42'6". Burr Oak and McMakin have no width printed on this sheet. Remaining long lines are lot lines.
